# Document collisions fixtures

`ucsc-record.json`: a college record shaped like UC Santa Cruz's (110714) on 2026-11-08, cut to a few items, with the
two manifest entries (specs/product/document-collisions.md "The incident"):

- `420859b8b6…` the official PDF from www.ucsc.edu, filed 2024-25 from its cover, pulled 2026-10-19, read by Sonnet
  (C) and Haiku (rest); one item with a check failure.
- `f38e8289ef…` a Google Drive copy, filed 2025-26 by assumption, pulled 2026-10-26, read by Sonnet; every item carries
  the edition-mismatch failure an assumed edition gets.

Against each other: 4 items agree (C.102, C.116, C.905, H.101), 3 differ (C.101, C.901, G.101), 2 only in the official
file (B.101, C.1001), 1 only in the Drive copy (B.2201). Generated by hand; tests: tests/document-collisions.test.mts.
